name: boat-mqtt-node
description: An MQTT broker node anyone can run, reached over HyperDHT by public key: devices (BoAT on ESP32, or any HyperDHT peer) find nodes by topic and log in with their key, and only the holder of a key may publish under it

scripts.test: node test/run.js && node test/store.js && node test/gateway.js
